notes: Five distinct manipulation episodes are visible: one lounge-chair backrest adjustment followed by four separate barbecue-part episodes. The initial and final balcony traversals were treated as scene surveys rather than interactions.
scene_description: A user moves around a covered apartment balcony containing a white adjustable lounge chair and a stainless-steel gas barbecue, manipulating several movable parts while the camera frequently rolls and changes viewpoint.
